newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Ekran details Bakun dam stock listing.
newsitem.headline: Ekran details Bakun dam stock listing.

text.p: Ekran Bhd, the main contractor of the $5.5 billion Bakun hydroelectric dam, said the proposed stock listing of the Bakun dam holding company will involve a total of 1.5 billion shares.

In its just-released 1996 annual report, Ekran said the Bakun Hydro-Electric Corp Bhd listing will consist of a public issue of 375 million shares and a special issue of 1.13 billion shares to five major shareholder groups.
The 2,400-megawatt capacity Bakun dam, in the East Malaysia state of Sarawak on Borneo island, is to be completed by 2002.

The public issue will consist of 225 million shares to the Malaysian public at 2.00 ringgit per share and 150 million shares to foreigners through a placement at not less than 2.00 ringgit a share, Ekran executive chairman Ting Pek Khiing said in the report's November 18 letter to shareholders.

In addition, the Bakun company will make a special issue of 1.125 billion shares at 2.00 ringgit a share as follows: Ekran (480 million shares), the Sarawak State government and the Sarawak Electricity Supply Corp (420 million shares).

Other key shareholders are national pension fund the Employees' Provident Fund (75 million shares), Tenaga Nasional Bhd (75 million shares) and other investors to be nominated and approved by the Malaysian government (75 million shares), the report said.
Subsequent to Ting's November 18 letter, the government said this week that its investment arm Khazanah Holdings Bhd has taken up a five percent equity stake in the Bakun company.
Ting said Bakun Hydro-Electric was seeking approvals from relevant authorities for the stock offering, which was expected to be listed on the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange's main board.
